blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. The dominant deployment is the Stellar token CBOOCGZSVRSZFRE4U2NWR2B4RXYVJWRCBTGOUD2JPI2TDJPWMTJX7FZP, created by Spiko (GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H) with the same token wasm as the other Spiko Stellar tokens. Its transfer and safe_transfer methods require WHITELISTED_ROLE on both from and to, burn(account,amount,caller) burns an arbitrary account under BURNER_ROLE, pause is PAUSER_ROLE-gated and upgrade is owner-only. The instance binds the shared PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M. EVM deployments use the verified Spiko Token implementation: Token._update requires PermissionManager.canCall(from/to, token, 0xa9059cbb), and the same implementation exposes restricted pause(), restricted burn(address,uint256) and restricted UUPS upgrade. oracleRisk.summary: CACEIS calculates the SAFO fund NAV, which determines subscriptions and redemptions. Chainlink publishes the exact EURSAFO NAV through Ethereum proxy 0x799fdc55150583b5baa0b47065e1c901862c95d5. At block 26098764, description() returned EURSAFO NAV, decimals() returned 6, and aggregator() returned 0xe774bc668d300e3ac157e405149aaff89eed1df6. The EURSAFO/EURCV Morpho oracle 0x8bb55b19f2ea18d4684b59a3b768a1926ab41409 uses this proxy as its immutable BASE_FEED_1. This establishes the external NAV publication path, without claiming independent valuation of CACEIS data, a second feed, or automatic failover. The documented feed heartbeat is 97200 seconds; the Morpho consumer does not enforce a staleness bound.

branchApplicability.rationale: EURSAFO is the EUR UCITS share class FR0014015LD3, valued at the fund NAV for subscriptions and redemptions. It has a top-level NAV publication authority, not borrower-specific liquidation branches. The separate Morpho lending market is an integration using the same NAV feed and does not turn EURSAFO's own issuance mechanism into a CDP.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spiko's cited 2025 CCIP announcement explicitly concerns EUTBL and USTBL, not EURSAFO. The EURSAFO deployments below are documented fund-share issuance routes; that source does not establish EURSAFO-specific CCIP participation. The existing adverse external-validation tier is retained pending token-specific transport and deployment-control evidence, rather than removed on the strength of an inapplicable announcement.
